name: Analyze EUR/USD and read the decision
description: Verifies a live analysis returns one decision with its reasons, a drawn chart and the market clock.
expected: The Signal panel shows a decision of BUY, SELL or NO TRADE with a 'Why' list containing at least one reason, a candlestick chart is drawn in the Chart panel, and the header shows the market clock reading 'FX open' or 'FX closed'.

name: Size a position and block an invalid stop
description: Verifies the position sizer returns the correct lots for a USD account and rejects a stop equal to the entry.
steps: In the Position sizer, set Entry to 1.10000, Stop to 1.09800, Target to 1.10400, Account to 10000, Risk % to 1 and Leverage to 30
expected: After the first calculation the result shows 0.50 lots with Loss at stop $100.00 and Gain at target $200.00. After the second calculation an error reading 'The stop cannot equal the entry' is visible.

name: Save a reading, keep it after reload, then delete it
description: Verifies a saved analysis survives a reload and a confirmed delete removes it for good.
steps: Select 'EUR/USD' in the Market dropdown and click 'Analyze'
In the Signal log, click the delete (trash) button on the EUR/USD 15m entry
expected: After the first refresh the Signal log shows a EUR/USD 15m entry. After the confirmed delete and the second refresh that EUR/USD 15m entry is no longer in the Signal log.

name: Show an error when the analysis fails
description: Verifies a failed analysis is shown as an error instead of a stale or empty signal.
expected: A red error message starting with 'Could not analyze EUR/USD' is visible and the Signal panel shows no BUY, SELL or NO TRADE decision.
